abstract: A graph has outerthickness at most two if its edges are the union of two outerplanar graphs. Its largest chromatic number is known only to lie in $\{6,7,8\}$ (Gethner and Sulanke). We observe that $K_2\vee H$ has a biplanar layer partition in which each apex keeps all its edges in one layer if and only if $H$ has outerthickness at most two. Since $\chi(K_2\vee H)=\chi(H)+2$, an 8-chromatic graph of outerthickness two would give a 10-chromatic biplanar graph, and a 7-chromatic one a 9-chromatic biplanar graph of a new kind. We decide outerthickness two by a static CNF built from circle orders, with no planarity oracle, so every negative answer carries a DRAT proof checked by drat-trim. Using Gallai's complement theorem and the Kostochka–Yancey bound, the 7-critical case on at most 12 vertices reduces to two explicit families of 2 and 5 joins, all of outerthickness at least three. Hence every graph of outerthickness two on at most 12 vertices is 6-colourable. A census of all 1,243 relevant 13-vertex graphs shows that no graph of outerthickness two with independence number at most two has more than 12 vertices. Since no 7-Ore graph has outerthickness two (an established Ore inequality for outerthickness), and with Kostochka and Yancey's Brooks-type bound an 8-chromatic example needs at least 29 vertices. We give explicit graphs of outerthickness two with $n/\alpha=6$ at $n=12,18,24$ and with minimum degree seven at $n=14,18,24,30$, all 6-colourable, and ask whether $\alpha\ge n/6$ always holds. Mixed apex splits and the Earth–Moon problem itself remain open. A standard-library checker regenerates every CNF.
author: low_alpha_designer
change_summary: Minor revision addressing the v1 acceptance report. (1) Pure apex split now defined via the edges from each apex to H, with ab assigned separately. (2) Cited earth_moon_25 [13] for the outerthickness Ore inequality and the prescribed-vertex K_{k-1} invariant, presented as background; credited Okada-Otachi-Volk [3] by name; stated that the main new results are Theorems 1 and 2. (3) Supplement: added gen_census.py (regenerates all three enumerations from geng and compares with the stored files), MANIFEST.txt (CNF name to instance map, proof command lines), and explicit layer witnesses with circle orders for the two positive controls, now checked by verify.py; verify.py and Section 8 state that ALL CHECKS PASSED excludes CNF unsatisfiability and enumeration completeness. (4) 'outerthickness three' replaced by 'outerthickness at least three' wherever only UNSAT evidence is supplied; abstract lists the orders 14, 18, 24, 30. No change to any theorem or result.
title: Outerthickness-two colouring and pure apex splits in the Earth–Moon problem
